(2) The Scandinavian legacy says the conversion-era dioceses were 'reformed rather than replaced at the Reformation', but no entry covers the Scandinavian church from 1104 to the 1520s; I drafted the continued-as link straight to scandinavian-reformation-kingdoms (era 7) at Inferential-Thin.
